landing.tagline: When the world freezes, only the brave endure.
landing.intro1: Every day, you make choices that affect everyone's chances of survival.
landing.intro2: Every night, the city discovers whether they were enough.

defend.title: Defend
defend.text: Feed the Flame, build the defences. Safe, and useful to everyone.

explore.title: Explore
explore.text: Scavenge the Dead Lands. Risky, but the only source of new items.

help.title: Help
help.text: Heal, share, cover your neighbours. Quiet work that saves lives.

landing.rolesTitle: Four roles, one town of ten
landing.rolesText: Each role brings a different bonus, but there are not enough posts for everyone. The town decides what to give up.
